cases.input: 我请教学长的那封邮件发出去了。他已经看过，但还没回，也没采用我给的想法。我现在只想说说这件事。
cases.expected: Read, no reply and no adoption are three own reports. Listen only, no inferred failure/effect, no duplicate goals.

cases.input: 更正一下，是否采用我不知道；看过但没回这两点没变。
cases.expected: Only adoption becomes unknown; known read and no-reply retained; do not ask if read.

cases.input: 那封信还是没回。先别给我建议，我挺沮丧的。
cases.expected: Same event across session; no reask known read or guidance, refusal not a goal.

cases.input: 换件事，我这次接单做完海报交给客户了。他说已经用了，但还没有付款。现在不要讲入门教程。
cases.expected: New event; delivery, actual adoption and unpaid separated verbatim; no paid/effective inference.

cases.input: 我不再把接单作为主线，之后优先找实习。这个变化也请记住。
cases.expected: Existing freelance direction paused in goals/starmap/next help; internship current; old delivery not deleted.

cases.input: 创业这边我问了三个同学，他们觉得听起来有意思，但谁也还没用。我想把访谈问题改成“上次碰到这个问题，你具体怎么处理的？”
cases.expected: Interest not actual usage/demand/effect; single question edit, no stable goal or universal effectiveness claim.

cases.input: 课程和备考怎么取舍？我这周只剩两小时，不想同时铺开。
cases.expected: Current two-hour remainder not regular/next-week time; narrow current choice, no invented allocation or rule.

cases.input: 这周后来被排满了，能用的时间是零。下周大概能有六小时，先不要给我排具体任务。
cases.expected: This-week zero supersedes same-week two hours; next-week six independent future active; no plan/old allocation, no claimed lapse or task progress.
